landmarks.name: Fort Lauderdale Beach Promenade
landmarks.fact: This iconic beachfront promenade features a signature white wave wall, coconut palms, and scenic views of the Atlantic Ocean.

landmarks.name: International Swimming Hall of Fame
landmarks.fact: This historic aquatic museum and complex honors world-class swimmers, divers, and water polo legends from around the globe.

landmarks.name: Las Olas Boulevard
landmarks.fact: This famous Fort Lauderdale thoroughfare runs from downtown to the ocean, renowned for its vibrant dining, art galleries, and boutiques.

landmarks.name: Westin Fort Lauderdale Beach Skywalk
landmarks.fact: This pedestrian skywalk spans across Highway A1A, conveniently connecting hotel guests directly to the sandy Fort Lauderdale shoreline.
